Sandeep Sharma, Judge (oral):

All the above captioned appeals are directed against the award dated 25.6.2011 passed by learned District Judge, Una, District Una, H.P. and as such, same are being taken up together for adjudication with the consent of learned counsel representing the parties.

entities.text: District Judge, Una, District Una, H.P.
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. By way of aforesaid appeals filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as the Act), challenge has been laid to common award dated 25.6.2011, passed by learned District Judge, Una, in Reference Petition No.1 of 2009 titled Jagat Ram vs. The Land Acquisition Collector & another alongwith other connected Land Reference petitions, as described in the award.

entities.text: Jagat Ram vs. The Land Acquisition Collector & another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Also in some cases the claimants have filed the Cross Objections against the said award.

3. Undisputedly, the suit land belonging to the claimants, situate in village Dilwan, Tehsil Amb,
District Una, H.P., came to be acquired for public purpose; namely; construction of "Nangal - Talwara Gauge Rail Line" and acquisition proceedings commenced with the issuance of Notification under Section 4 of the Act on 26.3.1998.
The Land Acquisition Collector (for short 'LAC') passed an award No.13 of 1999-2000, and awarded compensation of the acquired land as per the classification of the land mentioned in the award.

General Manager vs Jagat Ram & Another on 14 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22742400/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Claimants, being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the amount of compensation awarded by 'LAC',
preferred different reference petitions under Section 18 of the Act, before the learned District Judge,
Una, seeking .
therein enhancement of compensation, awarded by the Land Acquisition Collector.

Learned District Judge, Una vide common award dated 25.6.2011, passed in above numbered reference petition alongwith other connected matters awarded compensation at the rate of Rs. 270/- per square meters of land irrespective the classification of land in favour of the petitioners-claimants.
Besides above, compensation of Rs. 1, 00,000/- also came to be awarded in respect of the house acquired of petitioner Amar Nath.

5. Appellant, being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the aforesaid award passed by the learned District Judge, Una, has approached this Court by way of above captioned appeals, seeking therein restoration of award passed by the learned Land Acquisition Collector after setting aside the judgment/award passed by the learned District Judge, Una.

6. It is not in dispute that appeals arising out of similarly situate claimants, as also acquisition proceedings, stand disposed of by this Court vide judgment dated 23rd March 2018, passed in RFA No. 617 of 2011, titled as General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & others,
alongwith other connected matters.

entities.text: General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The present Appeals as also the Cross Objections are squarely covered by the said decision, as the issues involved are identical, which fact is not in dispute.

7. Mr. Balram Sharma, learned Deputy Solicitor General of India representing the appellant(s),
while fairly acknowledging the factum with regard to passing of judgment in RFA No. 617 of 2011,
(supra) was not .
able to refute the fact that claimants in the appeals at hand are also entitled to enhanced market value of acquired land, as has been held in the aforesaid Reference Petition, which was the basis for enhancing the compensation in the award under challenge in the appeals, and which has further been upheld by this Court in RFA No. 617 of 2011, (supra) alongwith other connected matters.

8. Consequently, in view of aforesaid discussion as well as fair stand adopted by Mr. Balram Sharma, learned Deputy Solicitor General of India, representing the appellant(s), present appeals are dismissed and it is ordered that directions contained in RFA No. 617 of 2011, titled as General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & others, decided 23rd March 2018, shall mutatis mutandis apply to the present cases also.
